A power struggle within Inheritor pact due brews over which race should watch over the 3 artifacts of the Abyss Wars: the [[Betrayer Gods]] [[Characters/Gods/Betrayers/Arkonil]], Voracia, and Korvus. In the end the Humans took Arkonil (crown), the Elves took Voracia (amulet), and the Dwarves took Korvus (ring).
